lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when an idempotency guard uses a strict inequality to reject duplicate out of order events e g where applied incoming add a test case for the exact equality boundary not just the strictly less than case or a mutation survives silently
lessons.text: When an idempotency guard uses a strict inequality to reject duplicate/out-of-order events (e.g. WHERE applied < incoming), add a test case for the exact-equality boundary, not just the strictly-less-than case, or a </<= mutation survives silently.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when classifying a domain exception as non retryable for a message broker retry interceptor add an end to end test that triggers that exact exception type through the real listener and broker not only a unit test of the exception being thrown or a retry policy misclassification for that type survives undetected
lessons.text: When classifying a domain exception as non-retryable for a message broker retry interceptor, add an end-to-end test that triggers that exact exception type through the real listener and broker, not only a unit test of the exception being thrown, or a retry-policy misclassification for that type survives undetected.

lessons.key: gate_fail::when naming integration test classes with the it suffix bind maven failsafe plugin to the integration test verify phases because maven surefire s default test goal does not match it java and mvn test silently reports success while skipping all it coverage
lessons.text: When naming integration test classes with the *IT suffix, bind maven-failsafe-plugin to the integration-test/verify phases, because Maven Surefire's default test goal does not match *IT.java and mvn test silently reports success while skipping all IT coverage.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when an ac s when clause lists multiple distinct triggering sub cases e g sem set local definido ou com o tenant errado write one test per sub case not just the easiest one to simulate since the untested sub case can behave differently error vs empty result than assumed
lessons.text: When an AC's WHEN-clause lists multiple distinct triggering sub-cases (e.g. 'sem SET LOCAL definido, ou com o tenant errado'), write one test per sub-case, not just the easiest one to simulate, since the untested sub-case can behave differently (error vs empty result) than assumed.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when proving a non retryable exception classification end to end assert on retry attempt count a spy on the listener invocation count or the broker s delivery death header not on downstream side effect absence or final dead letter queue arrival because both are identical whether the exception retries first or is rejected immediately
lessons.text: When proving a non-retryable exception classification end-to-end, assert on retry attempt count (a spy on the listener invocation count, or the broker's delivery/death header), not on downstream side-effect absence or final dead-letter-queue arrival, because both are identical whether the exception retries first or is rejected immediately.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a fix adds a decisive test signal for one exception type in a shared retry classification map add the equivalent decisive signal for every other entry in that same map not just the one that was reported as broken since sibling entries carry the identical unproven risk
lessons.text: When a fix adds a decisive test signal for one exception type in a shared retry-classification map, add the equivalent decisive signal for every other entry in that same map, not just the one that was reported as broken, since sibling entries carry the identical unproven risk.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when an ac names both a match and a no match branch for the same optional filter add a dedicated test for the no match branch instead of relying on a differently scoped empty list test to imply it
lessons.text: When an AC names both a match and a no-match branch for the same optional filter, add a dedicated test for the no-match branch instead of relying on a differently-scoped empty-list test to imply it.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec requires an error response to include an error message assert on the response body content not only the http status code
lessons.text: When a spec requires an error response to include an error message, assert on the response body content, not only the HTTP status code.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when an ac lists multiple independent filter parameters as cross tenant risks add one cross tenant test per parameter instead of testing only one and generalizing to the rest
lessons.text: When an AC lists multiple independent filter parameters as cross-tenant risks, add one cross-tenant test per parameter instead of testing only one and generalizing to the rest.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec requires an error path to skip a downstream call db cache assert that no call happened spy verify not just the resulting http status
lessons.text: When a spec requires an error path to skip a downstream call (DB/cache), assert that no call happened (spy/verify), not just the resulting HTTP status.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::before writing a design md rationale about a framework s internal error handling behavior e g spring cacheable sync true verify it empirically against the actual pinned framework version s bytecode source not general web search knowledge that may target an older version
lessons.text: Before writing a design.md rationale about a framework's internal error-handling behavior (e.g. Spring @Cacheable sync=true), verify it empirically against the actual pinned framework version's bytecode/source, not general web-search knowledge that may target an older version.
